artifact_observations.reasoning: The bandage lacks the expected micro-texture of fabric or plastic. It appears overly smooth and digitally 'painted,' lacking the fine weave or pore structure typical of real adhesive tape. The edges are also suspiciously perfect and soft, lacking the slight fraying or sharp cut definition of a physical object.

The complete absence of the central absorbent pad is a structural failure of the object's definition. A Band-Aid is defined by the pad; without it, it is just a strip of tape. This suggests the AI failed to generate the composite nature of the object.

The child's fingers interacting with the blue box appear slightly fused and lack clear joint definition. The geometry of the box lid is slightly warped, not aligning perfectly with rigid perspective lines.
